name: Logo
description: Client/company logo placeholder set. 10 variants (logo-1 to logo-10) representing different client organizations. 64×64px vector logo placeholders. Used in ContentBlock(OptionMenus) as company avatars, in CandidateCard for employer branding, and in AppBar when switching client context.

type.description: Which placeholder logo to show. In production, replace with the actual client logo image.

tokens.note: Logos themselves have no token bindings — they are brand assets. Container shape and size are determined by the parent context.

usage.notes: In production, these placeholder logos should be replaced with actual client logos fetched from the backend (image URL). Apply corner-radius.md for the container. Fallback to logo-1 (or a generic company icon) if no logo is available.

do: Always fetch the actual client logo from the backend in production.
Apply corner-radius.md to the wrapper for consistent appearance.
Show a generic company icon as fallback when logo URL fails to load.
dont: Don't hardcode placeholder logos in production UI.
Don't stretch logos — maintain original aspect ratio with object-fit: contain.
